origin.name: nu
origin.note: Public Nushell 0.110.0 source for Cyb's embedded libraries; upstream history preserved.

fix: Tail error expression in the non-SQLite history branch; identical error behavior

checks.command: nu -c 'use toolkit.nu; toolkit fmt --check; toolkit clippy'

cargo clippy --locked --lib -p nu-protocol -p nu-engine -p nu-parser -p nu-command -p nu-cmd-lang -p nu-cmd-extra -p nu-cli -p nu-std -p nu-utils -- -D warnings -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::unchecked_duration_subtraction
cargo test --locked --lib -p nu-protocol -p nu-engine -p nu-parser -p nu-command -p nu-cmd-lang -p nu-cmd-extra -p nu-cli -p nu-std -p nu-utils
cargo test --locked --features nu-cli/plugin -p nu-protocol -p nu-engine -p nu-parser -p nu-command -p nu-cmd-lang -p nu-cmd-extra -p nu-cli -p nu-std -p nu-utils
